facts.fact: Bombora, as a B2B data supplier, monitors over 2.6 million companies worldwide (vendor's own claim).
facts.quote: As a B2B data supplier monitoring over 2.6 million companies worldwide, Bombora’s scale of data is unparalleled.

facts.fact: Bombora's Audience Solutions are now available for all StackAdapt customers, per the April 2020 partnership announcement.
facts.quote: Bombora’s Audience Solutions are now available for all StackAdapt customers.

facts.fact: The StackAdapt and Bombora partnership expands Bombora's Audience Solutions to include ABM Audiences, Audience Verification and Company Surge for B2B programmatic campaigns.
facts.quote: This partnership expands Bombora’s Audience Solutions offerings beyond pre-packaged audiences to include Account-Based-Marketing (ABM) Audiences, Audience Verification and Company Surge®

facts.fact: Bombora's Company Surge analyzes the business content consumption of millions of B2B organizations to identify intensity of research spikes, considered an indicator of active demand.
facts.quote: Bombora’s Company Surge® analyzes the business content consumption of millions of B2B organizations to identify the intensity of research spikes for target organizations

facts.fact: ABM audiences let advertisers target specific companies from a target account list or CRM list at an individual level by mapping employee devices at those companies.
facts.quote: ABM audiences enable advertisers to target specific companies from a target account list or CRM list, at an individual level, by mapping employee devices at specific companies.
